question: Prevent self-reported precomputed stability means, early-survival penalty omissions, duplicate steps, and wrong selected-action credit from silently passing F8 R10 fabricated scientific gate.

metric.original_R5_metric: mean over 96 horizon of abs(pole_angle)/0.2095 + 0.1*abs(pole_angular_velocity)/3.5; missing step after early termination assigned penalty2.0
metric.time_index: score the observed post-selected-action physical state_after on each actually executed step; a proposed prospective interpretation requiring separate owner science qualification, not a claim R5 empirically specifies state selection
metric.episode_term: first 1..95 terminal requires terminated=true and truncated=false on last observed effect; event96 truncated=true; simultaneously terminated=true and truncated=true only valid at event96; no following effects
metric.real_validity: exact int/float finite (exclude bool) for every physical state element and reward; don't infer original source authority from submitted traces
metric.effects: one current chosen action (exact int 0 or1) and factual post-state per step; current target unseen at action-selection time, no unselected action after-state
metric.hypothetical_action_queries: for trained policy instances require exactly ordered [0,1] before each selected action; for fixed scripted control [] only; never count predictions as physical observations
metric.admission: all 22 registered arm+seed policy instances ×16 paired worlds, no extra/missing worlds, 352 sessions max, 33792 action cap, 67584 query cap; re-use exact R10 admission and forbid F8 owner receipts
metric.trial_metric_binding: derive mean_stability_cost and selected_actions / survival_steps from observed synthetic steps, never accept caller-supplied aggregated cost

negatives: fabricated incorrectly low reported summary cannot be supplied
early terminal n<96 without penalty cannot be passed
invalid step96 truncation and simultaneous step<96 trunc+term denied
step gap, duplicate, out-of-order, effect after terminal denied
early missing selected effect claimed as completed denied
three or duplicate hypothetical action queries denied
scoring world0 as separate new world for other model seed denied
hypothetical downstream R10 bootstrap 16-world logic re-used only; never SCIENTIFIC_PASS
